brief: Holds a complex number, a real part plus an imaginary part, and does its arithmetic: sum, product, quotient, modulus, argument, conjugate.
detail: Build one with new stzComplex(re, im). It follows the Softanza forms: an active verb (Conjugate, Negate) changes the number in place; the passive form (Conjugated, Negated, Plus, Times ...) returns the result as a [ re, im ] pair and leaves the number alone; the Q twin (ConjugatedQ, PlusQ ...) returns a new stzComplex to chain on. The other operand of Plus, Minus, Times, DividedBy and Equals may be a number, a pair or another stzComplex. Log, inverse trigonometry and general powers are absent on purpose. The factory function StzComplexQ(re, im) written at the end of the file is not reachable as a function today (error R3).
